title: Warm Spanish Toast
description: A simple and delicious breakfast or brunch option featuring warm, crispy bread topped with a blend of savory ingredients.

ingredients.name: Warm spices
ingredients.notes: Optional: smoked paprika, garlic powder, or dried oregano

instructions: Place the bread slices on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 2-3 minutes or until lightly browned.
While the bread is toasting, melt the butter in a small saucepan over low heat.
Add the warm spices to the melted butter and stir to combine.
Once the bread is toasted, brush the warm butter mixture evenly over each slice.
Sprinkle salt to taste and top with chopped parsley if desired.
